statements.status_notes: Upstream Git 2.54.1, which this package builds from, already contains the fix for this CVE. The upstream 2.54.1 release notes (https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.54.1/Documentation/RelNotes/2.54.1.adoc) state that the release merges up the fix that appears in v2.50.2, v2.51.3, v2.52.1 and v2.53.1. Those tags are ancestors of v2.54.1 and the fix is not reverted between them and v2.54.1. The aports 3.24-stable APKBUILD at the pinned revision applies no patch that undoes it. The scanner reports this artifact because it compares the Alpine version 2.54.1-r0 against the fixed range below 2.56.1-r0, not because the vulnerable code is present.

Per NVD the affected product is gitforwindows:git; the flaw is the Windows port leaking the NTLM hash during credential negotiation when cloning from an attacker-controlled server. The Windows credential/NTLM code path is not compiled in the Alpine musl build, so the vulnerable code is not present.
